name: Dialogue Portraits
description: Shows a portrait of whoever is talking, next to the dialogue box. INSET steals six tiles from the left of the box for a framed Game Boy panel; MARGIN paints the art out in the letterbox and leaves the box alone. Art is a pre-cropped, tightly-framed bust of the ROM's own battle portraits for the ~45 trainer classes and a curated list of story characters, tinted with BROWNMON (a real, saturated palette from the game's own data) -- nobody else gets a portrait unless a PNG is dropped in portraits/, which always wins. Speaker detection reads the dialogue's own "NAME: " prefix first when the ROM's text has one (e.g. "OAK: ", "{RIVAL}: "), then the running map script's own NPC, then the player's facing cell -- so scripted encounters and mid-script speaker changes are covered, not just plain talk.
